preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10,000, inclusive.
Each test case contains two integers x and y, each between 1 and 100, inclusive.

postconditions.description: If it is impossible to choose a pair of positive integers a and b, the output is [0, 0].
If it is possible to choose a pair of positive integers a and b, the output is [a, b].

postconditions.expression: exists a, b | (output[0] > 0 and output[1] > 0) such that (x * b^a == y)
postconditions.description: The output pair [a, b] must satisfy the equation x * b^a = y.
